hypothesis: Neuro-symbolic reinforcement learning with self-critiquing models generates and refines scientific hypotheses using domain constraints and logical checks, reducing AI hallucinations to produce valid, testable research proposals
description: This method combines neural networks for creative hypothesis generation with symbolic reasoning to enforce logical and scientific validity, while a self-critique loop evaluates plausibility against domain knowledge. By rewarding proposals that satisfy both novelty and consistency, the system avoids unsupported claims and aligns outputs with established scientific principles, offering a structured path toward trustworthy AI-assisted research design. The integration of symbolic constraints ensures that generated hypotheses remain interpretable and testable within real-world domains.

messages.content:
You will be given a research hypothesis in artificial intelligence, consisting of a Method, a Problem, and a Goal.
Rewrite it for a reader who is a researcher but not necessarily an AI specialist, in exactly this format:

Hypothesis: <ONE sentence of 20 to 30 words stating concretely what is done with the method, for which problem, to achieve which goal>
Description: <two or three sentences, 50 to 70 words in total, explaining the mechanism and why it could work>

Rules: the hypothesis sentence must have between 20 and 30 words: if the input is short, make it concrete by stating how the method would be applied; if the input is long, condense it to its core idea; begin the hypothesis sentence directly with the method (never with "This study", "This approach", "We", or similar); use plain, neutral language and at most one technical term per noun phrase; do not exaggerate; do not invent results, numbers, datasets, or citations; do not mention how the hypothesis was obtained; output only the two lines.

Method: Neuro-symbolic reinforcement learning with self-critiquing generative models
Problem: Hallucination in open-ended AI-generated scientific hypotheses
Goal: Produce falsifiable, domain-validated AI-generated research proposals
